about: Two live bad_deploy breaks on 2026-11-12, 17 minutes apart. First: break at 07:46:28, errors into ALARM at 07:47:05, cleared by hand at 07:47:35, OK at 07:48:05; its run was refused before any model call (a federation 401). Second: break at 08:03:10, errors into ALARM at 08:03:45, cleared at 08:04:54, OK at 08:05:35; the runtime's run diagnosed it. The second replay sees the first break's deploy and rollback 17 minutes earlier. No other alarm fired.
account: 123456789012 stands in for the account ID wherever AWS wrote it.

logs.note: Lines without their EMF _aws block, as the log tool shows them.

metrics.note: CloudWatch keeps 10-second data for 3 hours, so only 60-second periods remain.

message.S: Cache product lookups for a minute
Keep abandoned carts for two days
Revert the checkout DB pool size
Size the checkout DB pool to the new replica's connection limit
Cache product lookups for a minute
Sample a quarter of debug logs
Revert the checkout DB pool size
Size the checkout DB pool to the new replica's connection limit
Keep abandoned carts for two days
Cache product lookups for a minute
One structured log line per request
Read pool settings from the environment
Raise the payments-api client timeout to 2 s
